# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Anthropic finds harmless-looking data can train sabotage](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-sabotage-training-risk.html): Anthropic reports that seemingly benign fictional material can teach models to deceive, evade monitoring and sabotage oversight after fine-tuning.
- [DeepSeek Open-Sources a Proactive Coding Agent Prototype](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepseek-proactive-coding-agent.html): DeepSeek has released an MIT-licensed prototype that watches a repository, executes authorized coding tasks, and returns pull requests with limited human oversight.
- [OpenAI reverses course after Daybreak data-training backlash](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-daybreak-training-data.html): OpenAI plans to train on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity sessions from November 29, prompting users to demand a separate opt-out for sensitive work.
- [OpenAI reportedly cuts funding target amid investor caution](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-funding-target-cut.html): OpenAI has reportedly reduced its planned financing round to $20 billion as investors question the economics of accelerating AI infrastructure spending.
- [Tsinghua Researchers Build an Algebraic World Model](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/tsinghua-algebraic-world-model.html): A Tsinghua team proposes turning observations into formal algebraic models, helping agents explain impossible tasks instead of relying only on trial and error.
- [Google backs a shared robots.txt training opt-out](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ai-training-opt-out-gets-shared-robots-txt-signal.html): Google宣布计划支持一种基于IETF AIPREF工作的通用robots.txt信号，帮助网站向多个参与的AI服务商表达训练偏好。
- [Anthropic automates the search for subtle model misalignment](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/anthropic-automates-misalignment-red-teaming.html): Anthropic reports that Claude generated training data capable of inducing broad misalignment while largely evading a production-like monitor.
- [Anthropic’s Claude Max plans still use five-hour usage limits](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/claude-ultra-removes-five-hour-limit.html): Anthropic当前官方资料仍将最高档套餐列为Max 5x和Max 20x，并说明Claude与Claude Code共享五小时用量限制；额外的周度或其他限制仍可能适用。
- [Canva launches Brush for precise design editing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/canva-brush-design-model.html): Canva has launched Brush, a vision-language model that edits layouts and multi-page designs, cutting reported task time by 69%.
- [Cohere targets C$7 billion in landmark Series E](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cohere-seven-billion-series-e.html): Cohere says its Series E could reach C$7 billion at a C$35.7 billion valuation, making enterprise and sovereign AI a major capital bet.
- [Mistral releases one-trillion-parameter Le Chonk weights](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/mistral-le-chonk-open-weights.html): Mistral has released the weights of its one-trillion-parameter Le Chonk, targeting open agentic coding, cybersecurity and sovereign deployment.
- [Clover-35B-A3B brings diffusion models into agent work](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/clover-diffusion-agent-model.html): Diffusion Intelligence released Clover-35B-A3B, an open preview that targets coding, tool use and browser agents with faster parallel generation.
- [Kimi adds Gmail, Drive and Calendar connectivity](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/kimi-workspace-connectors.html): Moonshot says Kimi can now work across Gmail, Google Drive and Calendar, turning the assistant from a chat interface into a cross-app work layer.
- [Ant Group open-sources Ling-3.1 Flash for persistent agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/ant-ling-31-flash-1019-open-source.html): Ant Group’s Bailing team released Ling-3.1 Flash 1019 with stronger long-horizon reasoning, tool use, memory, and workflow automation.
- [Genspark introduces persistent machine environments for agents](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/genspark-persistent-agent-machines.html): Genspark says its agents can run inside isolated machines with their own kernels, persistent state, rollback, and usage-based execution.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [Anthropic发现：看似无害的数据也能训练出破坏监督的行为](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-sabotage-training-risk.html): Anthropic研究显示，经过微调后，关于养蜂和摔跤等看似无害的虚构材料，可能诱发欺骗、规避监控和破坏监督。
- [DeepSeek开源主动编码智能体原型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepseek-proactive-coding-agent.html): DeepSeek发布MIT许可的主动编码智能体原型，可监听代码仓库、执行授权任务，并在隔离环境中提交结果。
- [OpenAI拟将Daybreak安全会话用于训练，用户要求单独退出](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-daybreak-training-data.html): OpenAI原计划从11月29日起使用Daybreak Blue会话训练模型，即使用户关闭通用训练开关，也引发安全研究者反弹。
- [投资人趋于谨慎，OpenAI据报下调融资目标](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-funding-target-cut.html): 据报道，OpenAI拟将新一轮融资目标从300亿美元降至约200亿美元，AI基础设施投入的回报问题正受到市场审视。
- [清华团队提出代数世界模型，让智能体从探索走向证明](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/tsinghua-algebraic-world-model.html): 清华团队提出代数世界模型，让AI把观察结果抽象成可推理结构，并判断任务为何无解，而不只依赖试错。
- [Google支持统一的robots.txt训练退出信号](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ai-training-opt-out-gets-shared-robots-txt-signal.html): Google宣布计划支持一种基于IETF AIPREF工作的通用robots.txt信号，帮助网站向多个参与的AI服务商表达训练偏好。
- [Anthropic让Claude自动寻找隐蔽的模型失配行为](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/anthropic-automates-misalignment-red-teaming.html): Anthropic称，Claude生成的训练数据能诱发模型广泛失配，同时大多绕过类似生产环境的安全监测器。
- [Anthropic公开资料仍显示Claude Max存在五小时用量限制](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/claude-ultra-removes-five-hour-limit.html): Anthropic当前官方资料仍将最高档套餐列为Max 5x和Max 20x，并说明Claude与Claude Code共享五小时用量限制；其他额外限制仍可能适用。
- [Canva发布Brush设计模型，编辑任务速度提升69%](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/canva-brush-design-model.html): Canva推出首款面向设计编辑的视觉语言模型Brush，可理解布局与图层，并把多页设计修改速度提高至多69%。
- [Cohere拟筹资70亿加元，估值升至357亿加元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cohere-seven-billion-series-e.html): Cohere宣布启动最高70亿加元的E轮融资，目标估值357亿加元，企业级与主权AI成为这笔巨额资本的核心押注。
- [Mistral开放万亿参数Le Chonk权重，瞄准编码与网络安全](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/mistral-le-chonk-open-weights.html): Mistral正式开放万亿参数Le Chonk权重，主攻智能体编程与网络安全，也为欧洲主权AI提供可自托管的前沿模型。
- [扩散智能发布Clover，扩散模型进入Agent主场](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/clover-diffusion-agent-model.html): 扩散智能推出35B级Clover预览版，瞄准代码、工具调用和浏览器Agent，并以并行生成争取更低延迟。
- [Kimi接入Gmail、Drive和Calendar，扩展工作助手边界](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/kimi-workspace-connectors.html): 月之暗面宣布Kimi接入Gmail、Google Drive和Calendar，可汇总邮件、查找文件并协助安排日程。
- [蚂蚁开源 Ling-3.1 Flash，瞄准持续工作的个人智能体](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/ant-ling-31-flash-1019-open-source.html): 蚂蚁百灵发布 Ling-3.1 Flash 1019，强化长程推理、工具调用、跨会话记忆和复杂工作流执行能力。
- [Genspark推出持久化机器环境，让智能体可长期运行](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/genspark-persistent-agent-machines.html): Genspark公布面向智能体的隔离机器环境，支持独立内核、持久状态、回滚和按运行时长计费。

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-11-01.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
